Target 5->2 (in 5 of 6 sources, top-5 in four; YouGov liking is the only weak spot; gut #1). Costco 2->4 and Home Depot/Lowe's 3/4->5/6 shift down only to make room for Amazon/Target. Best Buy 12->7 (in 3 sources incl. Smarty #4; gut top-10). Trader Joe's 22->10 (YouGov grocery popularity 68% = top-10 store overall, GOBankingRates top-10; its low computed spot comes from NRF top-50 sales and the small multi-store polls omitting it; gut top-5, so placed where gut and YouGov agree rather than at #5). TJ Maxx 14->11, Macy's 15->12 (Smarty #7), Kohl's 27->13 (gut top-10; Smarty lists Kohl's 15-19% on price-match/returns, YouGov 62%; NRF #34 by sales and YouGov liking keep it out of top 12). Kroger 8->9 (gut #12, NRF #4). Ace Hardware 9->18 and 7-Eleven 10->19 moved down: their high computed spots rest on YouGov liking scores plus NRF sales and they were not on the gut list as a 'favorite store' answer. Albertsons (18) and Publix (24) dropped: Albertsons is a parent company whose NRF sales cover Safeway/Vons etc., and both are regional; replaced by Walgreens/Barnes & Noble which have national name recognition (Walgreens NRF #7, B&N YouGov 72%).
confidence: high for 1-6 (Walmart, Target, Amazon, Costco, Home Depot, Lowe's are in nearly every source), medium for 7-14, low-medium for 15-24. Caveats: no fetched open-ended 'favorite store' poll covering all retail categories exists; YouGov Ratings measures liking, not naming, and has no online-retailer category (Amazon penalized); Smarty (2021) and Morning Consult (2019) are older; GOBankingRates sample was women only. ACSI/critic data not used.
